newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorean construction shares soar on tax break news.
newsitem.headline: SKorean construction shares soar on tax break news.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's construction firms jumped during Thursday's morning session on news that tax breaks would be offered to infrastructure contractors from the second half of the year, brokers said.
The construction sub-index rose 6.49 percent to 304.03 in morning trading.
The tax break was aimed at attracting private-sector funds into government projects, the ministry said.
Samick Construction gained 240 won to its upper limit of 3,240, Hanjin Construction rose 710 won to its limit of 9,610 and Kuk Dong Construction climbed 560 won to its limit of 7,660.
